description: Daily summary air quality measurements (e.g. PM2.5, ozone) from EPA monitors in a US county for a date range within one calendar year: arithmetic mean, max value, AQI, site. Source: US EPA AQS.

county.description: 3-digit county FIPS code (e.g. "037" Los Angeles County; see epa-aqs.list_counties)

end_date.description: End date (must be in the same calendar year as begin_date) as YYYYMMDD (e.g. "20240101")

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000, default 200)

parameter_codes.description: AQS parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5 (e.g. "88101" PM2.5, "44201" ozone, "42101" CO; see epa-aqs.list_parameters)

state.description: 2-digit state FIPS code (e.g. "06" California, "36" New York)

name: epa_aqs.air_quality.get_daily_data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: EPA AQS Daily Air Quality
